description_en: Submits an asynchronous analysis task for enterprise Voice of the Customer (VOC)
kebab_example: aliyun quanmiaolightapp submit-enterprise-voc-analysis-task --workspace-id llm-xx --task-description '给你一条待分析文本数据，请你按照标签体系来对数据进行打标。' --extra-info '额外信息' --output-format '请直接输出json格式，不要输出其他内容：' --model-id qwen-max --tags tagDefinePrompt=xxxx tagName=xxxx --filter-tags tagDefinePrompt=标签抽取的定义的Prompt tagName=过滤标签名称 --contents text=xxxx id=id-xxxxx --url http://www.example.com/xxxx.txt --file-key oss://default/aimiaobi-service-prod/aimiaobi/temp/public/government_service_experience_feedback_summary.txt --api-key sk-xxxxxxxx --source-trace true --batch-task true --positive-filter true --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitEnterpriseVocAnalysisTask

parameters.example: 给你一条待分析文本数据，请你按照标签体系来对数据进行打标。
parameters.name: task_description

parameters.example: 请直接输出json格式，不要输出其他内容：
parameters.help_en: The prompt that describes the output format. If this parameter is not specified, the output is generated in JSON format based on the task description
parameters.help_zh: 输出格式描述提示词(不传的话默认会根据任务描述生成json格式)
parameters.name: output_format

fields.help_en: The prompt that defines the tag for the Large Language Model (LLM)
fields.help_zh: 给到大模型的标签定义Prompt
fields.name: tag_define_prompt

fields.help_en: The prompt that defines the filter tag for the LLM
fields.help_zh: 给到大模型的 筛选的标签定义Prompt
fields.name: tag_define_prompt

fields.help_en: The content. The number of characters cannot exceed 10,000
fields.help_zh: 素材内容（字符数不能超过1w个）
fields.name: text

parameters.help_en: The list of content to analyze. Specify one of \`url\`, \`fileKey\`, or \`contents\`. The array can contain a maximum of 200 items. To process more items, use the \`fileKey\` parameter or upload a file
parameters.help_zh: 待挖掘的素材内容列表（url、fileKey、contents 三选一）（此数组不超过200个，更多请走fileKey或contents文件形式）
parameters.name: contents

parameters.help_en: The URL of the content file to analyze. Specify one of \`url\`, \`fileKey\`, or \`contents\`. The file size cannot exceed 100 MB. The number of content items cannot exceed 60,000
parameters.help_zh: 待挖掘的素材内容文件URL(url、fileKey、contents 三选一)（整体文件大小不能超过100M，素材个数不能超过6w条）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: The file key of the content file to analyze. Specify one of \`url\`, \`fileKey\`, or \`contents\`. The file key is a unique key that you obtain after you upload a file on the Quanmiao Software as a Service (SaaS) page
parameters.help_zh: 待挖掘的素材内容文件FileKey(url、fileKey、contents 三选一)（fileKey 是从全妙SASS页面上传所获取到的唯一key）
parameters.name: file_key

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API key
parameters.name: api_key

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable traceability. If you enable traceability, you cannot customize the output format
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用溯源（启用溯源时不支持自定义outputformat）
parameters.name: source_trace

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the model's BATCH API. This reduces the cost by half and processes the task within 24 hours.

(The BATCH API is supported by stable and some latest versions of Qwen-Max, Qwen-Plus, Qwen-Flash, Qwen-Turbo, and Qwen-Long. It is also supported by QwQ series models, such as qwq-plus and qwq-32b-preview, and some third-party models, such as deepseek-r1 and deepseek-v3.)
parameters.name: batch_task

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform positive filtering. \`true\`: positive filtering (default). \`false\`: negative filtering
parameters.help_zh: 是否正向筛选（true-正向筛选，默认；false-反向筛选）
parameters.name: positive_filter

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. \`true\`: successful. \`false\`: failed
success.description_zh: 接口请求是否成功：true 成功，false 失败
success.title_en: 接口请求是否成功：true 成功，false 失败
